A quick timestamp example

2024-01-01T00:00:00Z is midnight on January 1, 2024 in UTC. Its Unix timestamp is 1704067200 seconds, or 1704067200000 milliseconds.

A little more clarity

Good questions.
Simple answers.

Understand the formats before you copy the result.

What is a Unix timestamp?

A Unix timestamp counts seconds since January 1, 1970 at 00:00:00 UTC, excluding leap seconds. Some systems use milliseconds instead. Select the unit that matches your source.

Why use ISO 8601 instead of 01/02/2026?

Slash-separated dates mean different things in different locales. An ISO date such as 2026-02-01 makes the year, month, and day explicit. For a precise instant, include time and a timezone offset.

Does changing the timezone change the timestamp?

No. A timestamp identifies an instant. Different timezones display that instant as different local dates and times. Daylight saving rules can affect the offset.

Are conversion inputs uploaded?

Conversions are designed to run in your browser without uploading your input. Hosting requests and any advertising services are separate; see the privacy policy for their details.

Which conversions are included?

The initial toolkit covers dates, measurement units, data storage, number bases, and text encoding. Document and video conversion, and live currency rates, are outside this version's scope.
